brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net write a proposal outlining what such tools might be used for, why communities might like them, and outlining some of the design parameters and choices to be made

use yourself and attie.ai and minomobi.com as some examples of recent work in the space

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@alexbenzer.com: the bsky design team is working on communities and looking for feedback. 

one core idea we have is builders should be able to create apps and websites for their communities. they shouldn't only show up on bsky. 

community builders: would you want to create a separate custom app/site?
note: wrote a proposal on community-built apps for the bsky design team's thread, using myself, minomobi.com, and attie.ai as three live examples: buildthis.bisks.net/proposal
